m: अव-घात &c. See अव-√ हन्.
अव-घात m. a blow, Sāh. &c.
threshing corn by bruising it with a wooden pestle in a mortar of the same material, Jaim.; Kathās. &c.
(for अव घट्ट, q.v.) a hole in the ground, L.
a: अवघातः — [अव हन्-घञ्] 1 Striking. --2 Hurting, killing. --3 A violent or sharp blow, stroke or blow in general; कर्णावघातनिपुणेन च ताड्यमाना दूरीकृताः करिवरेण (भृंगाः) Nītipr. 2; अधरे दत्तदंतावघाते S. D. --4 Threshing corn by bruising it with a wooden pestle in a mortar. --5 Unnatural or accidental death.

v: tri॰ tava + hana--Rini । avaGAtake striyAM NIp ।
m: अव-घातिन् mfn. ifc. threshing, BhP.
striking, L.
अव-√ घूर्ण् (p. -घूर्णमान) to move to and fro, be agitated, Daś.
a: अवघूर्ण् — {c1c} U. To whirl round, brandish, move to and fro; as in अवघूर्णमानताम्रदृष्टिः; वने यथा शाल इवावघूर्णितः Mb. rocked to and fro.

v: na॰ ava + GUrRRa--BramaRe BAve lyu । sarbDatoBramaRe ।

m: अव-घूर्ण mfn. shaking, agitated, BhP.
अव-घूर्णित mfn. id., MBh. ix, 3239.

v: na॰ ava + Gfza--lyuw । aDaHsTApayitvA 1 GarzaRe sarva to 2 GarzaRe “durnyAsAt vraRavartmAvaGarzaRam” suSrutaH 3 mArjane ca malAvaDarzaRam pAtrAvaGarzaRam” salilEH SudDiretezAM gobAlEScAvaGarzaRAt” yA॰ smf॰ ।
m: अव-घर्षण n. rubbing off, scrubbing, Suśr.; Yājñ. iii, 60.
a: अवघर्षणं — 1 Rubbing into. --2 Grinding. --3 Cleaning, rubbing off; सलिलैः शुद्धिरेतेषां गोवालैश्चावघर्षणात् Y. 3. 60.

m: अव-घटरिका f. N. of a musical instrument, ŚāṅkhŚr. (cf. घाटरी.)
अव-√ घट्ट् Caus. (p. -घट्टयत्) to push away, push open, R. v, 15, 10 (Gorresio); to push together, rub, Suśr.; to stir up, Car.; Suśr.
a: अवघट्ट् — {c1c} A. 1 To push or brush away or off. --2 To split, break or cut asunder; पंचबाणान् अवघट्टयंती Dk. 124. --3 To touch, feel, rub; जलौकोव्रणान्मधुनाऽवघट्टयेत् Suśr. --4 To stir up, agitate.

s: puM, (ava + Gawwa + ADAre GaY .) BUranDraM । garttaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: pu॰ ava + Gawwa--ADAre GaY । BUmiranDre 1 Cidre trikA॰ karaRe GaY । 2 Garawwe (yA~tA) pezaRayantramede । BAve GaY । 3 cAlane GawwanAkriyAyAm BAve lyuw । avaGawwanaM tatrEvArTe na॰ । “pradeSasya bahuSo'vaGawwanAdayohi vyaDA” suSrutaH । yuc । tatrEvArTe strI ।
m: अव-घट्ट m. n. cave, cavern, L.
a: अवघट्टः — 1 A hole in the ground, a cave, a cavern. --2 A grindstone, stone-mill for grinding corn. --3 Stirring up, shaking.

m: अव-घट्टन n. pushing together, rubbing, Suśr.
coming into contact with each other, MBh. iv, 354.
अव-घट्टित mfn. rubbed or pushed together, Hariv. 4720.
अव-√ घृष् (ind.p. -घृष्य; 3. pl. -घृष्यन्ति for Pass. ˚ष्यन्ते) to rub off, rub to pieces, Suśr.; Pañcat. : Caus. (p. -घर्षयत्) to rub or scratch off, Suśr.; to rub with, ib.
a: अवघृष् — {c1c} U. To rub off, rub to pieces, grind to powder; मृदुना सलिलेन खन्यमानान्यवघृष्यंति गिरेरपि स्थलानि Pt. 1 v. l. --Caus. To rub off, scratch.

v: ava + Guwa--parivarttokta । sarvvatovezwite samantAt parivfte । saha “SivikayA prAyAdavazowitayA svanagaramanuprApya” BA॰ va॰ pa॰ ।
m: अव-घोटित mfn. (√ घुट्), (said of a palanquin) ‘covered’ or ‘cushioned (?)’, MBh. iii, 13155.
a: अवघोटित — a. Covered on all sides, concealed.

m: अव-घोष m. See जयावघोष.
अव-घोषणा f. announcement, publication, Jātakam.

v: na॰ ava + Guza--BAve lyuw । sarvvajanajYAnAyoccErGozaRe yuc । avaGozaRApyatra strI
m: अव-घोषण n. proclaiming, L.

अव-√ घ्रा (Imper. 2. pl. -जिघ्रत; Pot. -जिघ्रेत् [TS.; Mn. iii, 218] or -घ्रायात् [ĀśvŚr.] ind.p. -घ्राय) to smell at, VS. &c.; to touch with the mouth, kiss, PārGṛ. &c.: Caus. -घ्रापयति, to cause to smell at, TS.; ŚBr.; TBr.
a: अवघ्रा — {c1c} P. 1 To smell at; touch with the mouth; Ms. 3. 218. --2 To kiss (as the head); मूर्धनि त्रिरवघ्राय Āśval.; अवघ्रातश्च मूर्धनि Rām. --Caus. --(घ्रापयति) To cause to smell at.

v: na॰ ava + GrA--BAve lyuw । AGrARe “piRqapitfyajYavaddAnapraBfti prAgavaGrARAt” kA॰ 20511 “apaGrARamitarezu” kA 22, 10, 4 । idaYca BojanAnukalpatayA SizwE ruktam । ataeva SrAqvaSezaBojanasyAvaSyakatayA upavAsadine tadavaGrARamAtram vihitam “AGrAya pitfmevita miti” smftestaTAcaraRam ।
m: अव-घ्राण n. smelling at, KātyŚr.
smelling, BhP.
a: अवघ्राणं — The act of smelling at.

m: अव-घ्रापण n. causing to smell at, ĀpŚr.
अव-घ्रात mfn. kissed, R. ii, 20, 21.
अव-घ्रायम् ind. so as to smell at, KātyŚr.
अव-घ्र mfn. ‘kissing’, being in immediate contact with, ĀpŚr.
अव-घ्र m. (= अव-घ्राण) smelling at, ib.
अव-घ्रेय mfn. to be smelt at, TBr.
अव-√ घुष् (Pass. impf. -घुष्यत) to proclaim aloud, Hariv. 3522.
a: अवघुष् — {c1c} P. 1 To proclaim aloud. --2 To send for, summon, convoke; as a conclave (समाज). --3 To fill with cries, make resonant; नदीषु कौंचावघुष्टासु Mb.

m: अव-घुषित mfn. approved of Pāṇ. vii, 2, 23, Kāś.
अव-घुष्ट mfn. ‘proclaimed aloud’, offered publicly (as food), MBh. xiii, 1576 (cf. घुष्टान्न and संघुष्ट)
sent for, summoned, MBh. i, 5321
addressed aloud (to attract attention), Hariv. 4696
filled with cries or noise, MBh. xiii, 522.
